up: Retrieve compounds that show selectivity for JAK2 (CHEMBL2971) over JAK1 (CHEMBL2835). Selectivity is defined as: IC50 < 50 nM against JAK2 AND IC50 > 200 nM against JAK1. Use only activity rows where standard_relation = '=' and standard_units = 'nM'. Return each qualifying compound once only, using set semantics over compound identity (do not multiply rows by joining raw activity tables directly). Return exactly two columns: compound_chembl_id (the public ChEMBL identifier from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures).
sql:
WITH jak2_hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2971'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value < 50
),
jak1_hits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2835'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.standard_value > 200
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM jak2_hits j2
JOIN jak1_hits j1 ON j2.molregno = j1.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON j2.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno;
